key_facts: Vendor Patel Yarn Mills filed GSTR-1 late on 18.07.2025 (will reflect in subsequent GSTR-2B); Mumbai Trading Co posted invoice to B2C section by mistake — amendment expected; Rs. 52,000 is genuine error by accountant, client willing to reverse with interest. case_law_preference: Emphasize Rule 36(4) and Madras/Bombay HC rulings on vendor non-compliance
